Pivot a species ranking to one row per unit (wide)

Source: R/regen_rank_species.R
regen_rank_to_wide.Rd

Reshape the long output of regen_rank_species to one row per unit with essence_r / score_r / label_r / facteur_r columns for each rank r = 1..top_n — convenient for a per-unit table or a map join.

Usage

regen_rank_to_wide(ranked, top_n = 3)

Arguments

ranked

The long data.frame returned by regen_rank_species.

top_n

Number of ranks to spread into columns (default 3).

Value

A data.frame with ug_id and, per rank, essence_r (species code), score_r (suitability), label_r (name) and facteur_r (limiting factor).

See also

regen_rank_species
